title: VTC — shared invitation-credential definitions
description: Shared types for the vtc/invitations/* family. An Invitation Credential (VIC) is a single-use credential that admits its subject to a community; `issue` mints one, `list` enumerates the registry, `revoke` flips its status-list bit.

InvitationSummary.title: InvitationSummary
InvitationSummary.description: Registry view of one issued Invitation Credential. Carries no credential material — the VIC itself is returned only once, by `issue`.

role.description: Role granted on redemption, when the invitation names one.

issuedBy.description: DID of the operator who issued it.

validUntil.description: Expiry, when the invitation is time-bounded.

revokedAt.description: When it was revoked; absent while live.
